proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item UnitRecord kind exists. UnitRecord is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. A MagicItemRecord top-level kind and a corresponding magic-item mechanics family are required before any magic item can be encoded.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.daily_at_dawn
proposed_widenings.justification: The medallion regains 1d4 charges daily at dawn — a time-of-day cadence with no rest trigger. The current RestResetCadence union only covers short/long rest variants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The medallion regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: DcSource.item_fixed_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: The medallion casts Detect Thoughts at a fixed save DC 13, independent of the wearer's spellcasting stat. DcSource only models caster_spell_save_dc and weapon_attack_dc.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 charge to cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) from it

notes: Primary blocker is structural: MagicItemRecord does not exist in UnitRecord. Secondary widenings (daily-at-dawn cadence, item-fixed DC) would also be needed even if the kind existed. The charge resource atom (v4 'charge') exists in the taxonomy but no surface type models the dice-based dawn refill shape.
